major_cooldowns.name: Frozen Orb
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown through as many enemies as it can roll over, then follow it with Blizzard while Freezing Rain is up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Frozen Orb shares its name with 84721; 84714 is the cast id seen in all sampled parses.

major_cooldowns.name: Ray of Frost
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Get the full channel off early in the opener and never sit on both charges, and Shimmer to safety rather than cancelling it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: base_cd_s is 60 per charge; Hand of Frost grants a second charge at level 90, so the effective cadence is two charges of 60s.

major_cooldowns.name: Time Warp
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it just before a Ray of Frost channel or whenever your group calls for it, since you get one per boss fight.

defensives.name: Ice Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Shield up before the pull and re-apply it the moment it breaks, keeping a second charge banked for known damage.
defensives.id_note: Glacial Bulwark and Improved Ice Barrier give this two charges.

defensives.name: Alter Time
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it before a big hit and press it again to snap back to your earlier health and position.
defensives.id_note: Alter Time shares its name with 342246 (the self aura) and 342247 (the return cast); 342245 is the initial cast.

defensives.name: Mirror Image
defensives.usage_rule: Summon the images to cut incoming damage through a heavy phase while you keep casting.
defensives.id_note: CAST in 1/5 sampled parses (2 casts); talent build dependent.

defensives.name: Greater Invisibility
defensives.usage_rule: Vanish out of heavy damage or a targeted mechanic when you need to drop threat as well.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Ice Block
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it for a hit you cannot otherwise survive or to wipe a lethal debuff off yourself.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; replaced by Ice Cold when that talent is taken.

defensives.name: Ice Cold
defensives.usage_rule: Take it over Ice Block when you need to survive a huge hit without dropping your casts or aggro.
defensives.id_note: Ice Cold shares its name with 414659; 414658 is the cast id seen in all sampled parses.

rules.description: Frostbolt into Flurry, Frozen Orb, then Ray of Frost
rules.action: Open with Frostbolt, then Flurry, Frozen Orb, and Ray of Frost.
Press Flurry as soon as Brain Freeze procs, holding it only while Thermal Void is still running.

rules.description: Ray of Frost at low Icicles
rules.action: Fire Glacial Spike to dump your Icicles before you channel Ray of Frost.

rules.description: Blizzard once the pack is grouped
rules.action: Weave Blizzard into the rotation on grouped enemies and press it as soon as Freezing Rain is up after Frozen Orb.

rules.description: Time Warp just before Ray of Frost
rules.action: Send Time Warp with a Ray of Frost charge ready so the channel lands inside the haste.

source_summary: Frost's damage cooldowns are Ray of Frost and Frozen Orb, both kept rolling, with Ray of Frost banking a second charge from Hand of Frost so one can be saved for a vulnerability window or priority add. Time Warp goes out just before a Ray of Frost channel or wherever the raid calls it. Everything else is proc reaction: spend Brain Freeze with Flurry unless Thermal Void is still running, dump Fingers of Frost with Ice Lance, and add Blizzard once three or more enemies are up.
